title: ever OPAHL|Silver Metallic Fabric V-Neck A-Line Evening Dress Featuring Delicate Ruffled Hem
descriptionHtml:
Shimmer and shine in this stunning silver evening dress. The metallic fabric catches the light beautifully, while the flattering V-neck and A-line silhouette enhance your natural elegance. A delicate ruffled hem adds a playful yet sophisticated touch, making it ideal for galas, weddings, or any glamorous occasion.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Tea Length.


Sleeve Style: Short Sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric: The garment comprises polyester.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
